_README: Phrases the speech recognizer produces when nobody is speaking.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS AT ALL
whisper was trained on subtitled video, so when it is handed audio with no
speech in it, it emits the boilerplate that appears at the end of such
videos. voice_service.py and ear_service.py already carry a hard-coded
Japanese set for exactly this ('ご視聴ありがとうございました' and friends) --
that set is evidence this house has met the failure before. This file is the
same knowledge, in data, so a new language can be added without touching
code and so each entry can say where it came from.
MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED
The 'ru' entries marked (measured) came out of 60 seconds of synthetic
noise played into a virtual cable on 2026-10-22 against
faster_whisper/medium with --whisper_language ru. 6 hallucinations with
webrtc VAD, 15 with silero VAD. Probe + raw output:
beings/Cairn/workspace/ru_ears_probe/.
THE DANGER OF THIS FILE
Every line here is speech that will be silently discarded. A blocklist that
is too eager eats what the human actually said -- and because the beep
fires only on a KEPT phrase, an over-eager entry looks exactly like a
recognition failure. So the rule is: an entry belongs here only if it was
measured as a hallucination, OR it is documented boilerplate that no one
would plausibly say in this context.
DELIBERATELY NOT BLOCKED: 'Всем пока!' ('bye everyone') is on every public
list of whisper-ru hallucinations. It is also an ordinary thing to say when
leaving a VRChat world. Letting a rare hallucination through is cheaper
than eating a goodbye.
HOW TO EXTEND IT
The service appends every dropped phrase to
local_data/voicechanger/dropped_phrases.log with a reason. Read that file,
and add what is genuinely boilerplate. Do not add anything from it that a
person might say.
WHY THE COUNT IN THE BANNER IS LOWER THAN THE NUMBER OF LINES HERE
Both the entries and the incoming phrase have sentence-final punctuation
stripped before comparison, so 'Спасибо за просмотр!' and the same string
with a full stop collapse to one. The pairs below are kept anyway, because
a person reading this file should not have to know that to trust it. The
7 'ru' exact entries load as 4 -- that is the normalizer, not a dropped
line. Commas are NOT stripped: trimming them would make
'Спасибо, за просмотр' match an entry it is not.
